context: The current Web UI questionnaire interface uses standard Bootstrap radio buttons with the form-check-input class. Users have reported that these radio buttons are too light colored and barely visible, making it difficult to interact with questionnaires. This questionnaire helps determine the best approach to improve radio button visibility while maintaining a professional, modern appearance.

questions.question-text: What approach should be used to make the radio buttons more visible?

options.label: Increase the size of radio buttons using CSS transform scale
options.pros: Easy to implement, maintains Bootstrap styling, visually prominent, no structural changes needed
options.cons: May look oversized on some screens, scaling can cause alignment issues with text

options.label: Add custom CSS to increase border width and use darker colors
options.pros: Subtle improvement, maintains Bootstrap structure, professional appearance, responsive-friendly
options.cons: May not be dramatic enough for users with visibility issues, requires careful color selection

options.label: Replace radio buttons with larger button-style options (Bootstrap btn-group approach)
options.pros: Very visible, modern UI pattern, excellent for touch interfaces, clear selection state
options.cons: Breaks away from standard form pattern, takes more space, more significant code changes

options.label: Combine size increase with custom colors and add a subtle background highlight on hover
options.pros: Comprehensive solution, addresses multiple visibility aspects, better user experience, accessible
options.cons: More CSS to maintain, slightly more complex implementation

questions.recommendation-rationale: Option D provides the most comprehensive solution by addressing both the size and color issues while adding interactive feedback. This ensures maximum visibility for all users while maintaining a professional appearance and improving accessibility. The combination of techniques ensures the solution works well across different screen sizes and user preferences.

questions.question-text: Should the visibility improvements apply to all form radio buttons or only questionnaire radio buttons?

options.label: Only questionnaire radio buttons
options.pros: Targeted fix, doesn't affect other UI elements, easier to maintain specific styling
options.cons: Inconsistent UI if other radio buttons remain light, may confuse users

options.label: All radio buttons across the entire Web UI
options.pros: Consistent user experience, unified styling, improves overall usability, future-proof
options.cons: Broader scope, need to test all pages, may affect execution mode selector appearance

questions.recommendation-rationale: Applying the visibility improvements to all radio buttons creates a consistent user experience throughout the Web UI. This ensures users don't encounter the same visibility issues elsewhere and maintains design consistency. The execution mode selector on the Active Prompt page also uses radio buttons and would benefit from improved visibility.

questions.question-text: What specific CSS properties should be modified to improve visibility?

options.label: Size only (width, height, min-width, min-height)
options.pros: Simple, focused change, maintains color scheme, minimal risk
options.cons: Doesn't address color contrast issues, may not be enough for low-vision users

options.label: Color only (border-color, background-color when checked)
options.pros: Improves contrast, accessible, maintains current size, WCAG compliant
options.cons: May not be noticeable enough if buttons remain small

options.label: Both size and color (comprehensive styling)
options.pros: Maximum visibility, addresses all aspects, better for accessibility, works for all users
options.cons: More CSS code, requires testing to ensure good appearance

options.label: Size, color, and interactive states (hover, focus, checked)
options.pros: Complete solution, excellent UX, accessibility-friendly, provides visual feedback
options.cons: Most complex, requires thorough testing, more maintenance

questions.recommendation-rationale: A comprehensive approach that modifies size, color, and interactive states provides the best user experience. This ensures visibility in all states (default, hover, focus, checked) and improves accessibility. Adding hover and focus states helps users understand which option they're about to select, improving overall usability.
